name: milestone-timeline-01
title: Milestone Timeline 01 - Reached And Not Yet
description: A dated sequence of what a system has reached, on a rail with a rule down one side, a state mark per milestone and a composed Progress fill for the milestones that were work rather than a moment. Distinct from Timeline, which shows a live run, and from Story01, which arranges a company's past. Every string and every number is passed in as a prop.
